verdicts.explanation: Section 2.1 states the slow cooled Na2ZrCl6 sample has 6.6×10−8 S cm−1 at room temperature, from this work's EIS, with no citation marker. The null temperature field is correct because the paper gives only 'room temperature'.
The 2.6×10−5 S cm−1 value for twice ball milled Na2ZrCl6 is explicitly attributed to the authors' previous work (ref. 21), so literature_cited is correct.
The 9.5×10−8 S cm−1 at 25 °C value is given for the twice ball milled sample and is cited to ref. 21 ('respectively 21'), so literature_cited and 25 °C are correct.

The 'respectively' list maps 6.6e-5, 1.3e-5 and 9.5e-6 to twice ball milled, quenched and slow cooled. The parenthetical 'reported elsewhere 21' attaches only to the first two, so the slow cooled 9.5×10−6 value is a new measurement and experimental is correct.
The 6.6×10−5 S cm−1 value for twice ball milled Na2.25Y0.25Zr0.75Cl6 is explicitly marked 'reported elsewhere 21', so literature_cited is correct and the value is mapped correctly.
The 1.3×10−5 S cm−1 value for the quenched NYZC75 sample is marked 'reported elsewhere 21' and mapped correctly, so literature_cited is right and the synthesis description matches the paper.
The paper states the pellet was hot pressed at 300 °C for 4 h and gives 2.3×10−6 S cm−1 as an experimental value. No EIS temperature is stated, so the null measurement temperature is correct.

The paper gives 'σ293 K over 6.0×10−4 S cm−1' as a bound for the average over mixed-TM structures, not a specific value for one material. The record presents it as a point conductivity for a single material, so the conductivity meaning is not faithfully captured.
